title: Built for the Moment: Political Advertising that Reaches Voters When it Matters Most
summary: Make every election moment count. Explore third-party data and audience activation for 2026 political advertising with LiveRamp’s Data Marketplace.
body_markdown:
The 2026 midterms are on pace to set a political advertising spending record. Political advertising is paid communication that promotes candidates, ballot measures, or policy positions. AdImpact’s projection estimates spending could reach[$11.6 billion](https://adimpact.com/reports/adimpacts-updated-political-projections-report-2025-2026) , more than the previous midterm record set in the 2022 and 2024 cycles.


As the general election approaches, political advertisers are shifting their focus from overall ad spend to the moments that could shape the outcome: a strong debate performance, an early voting deadline, breaking news, or a new poll. However, reaching voters at high-impact moments requires clear audience insights. These insights become possible with access to accurate[third-party data](https://liveramp.com/resources/heres-the-deal-maximizing-third-party-data-strategy) . How fast you can enrich voter insights and activate new audiences is your greatest competitive advantage, helping your campaigns reach voters before they cast their ballot.


## Key takeaways


- **Political advertising spending is projected to reach a record $11.6 billion.** The compressed timeline between now and November creates higher risk for campaigns that are slow to activate and optimize audiences.
- **Connected data and fast activation help campaigns respond to key political moments.** An audience segment delivered too late misses voters when you need to reach them most.
- **A marketplace helps advertisers access multiple political data partners.** LiveRamp connects buyers with sellers responding to this election cycle’s growing demand.
- **Activating audiences across channels turns data into reach** and connects your ads with voters where they spend time during the election’s biggest moments.

## Political advertising FAQs


### What is the LiveRamp Data Marketplace?


LiveRamp’s Data Marketplace is a centralized, neutral marketplace that connects data buyers with trusted third-party data from 200+ data sellers and 650+ partners, including political organizations.


### Does LiveRamp sell its own political data?


No. LiveRamp is a neutral marketplace providing third-party political data sellers access to over 600 activation destinations.


### Why does speed matter more for political data than other categories?


Political campaigns work toward a fixed election deadline. A delay can mean an audience segment misses a key campaign moment or arrives after voters have cast their ballots.


### Does LiveRamp favor any political data seller or perspective?


No. Every data seller in LiveRamp’s Data Marketplace has the same access to buyers and the same activation tools, regardless of the audiences or causes they serve.
